passage.label: By mount; Book inscribed; parchment spread open; frequented House; ceiling raised high; sea set fire; indeed punishment Lord occur; no preventer; Day heaven sway circular motion; mountains pass departing; woe Day deniers; within discourse falsehood amusing; Day thrust toward fire Hell violent shove angels say; this Fire used deny; magic or not see; enter burn patient impatient same only recompensed used do

arabicExcerpts.text: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Six oaths by the Mount, an inscribed Book on spread parchment, the frequented House, the raised ceiling and the sea set on fire grounding the certainty of the Lord's inevitable punishment that none can prevent; the Day the heaven sways and mountains depart bringing woe to deniers absorbed in false amusement; their violent shoving toward Hell where angels declare this is the Fire they denied, challenged whether it is magic or they cannot see; told to burn patiently or impatiently since both are equal — they are only being recompensed for their deeds
